item.title: Former Rep. Buck Tells Newsmax: Tax Increases Won't Solve Fiscal Crisis
item.description: Former Rep. Ken Buck, R-Colo., told Newsmax that tax increases cannot resolve the nation's fiscal problems and that cutting federal programs is the only viable path.

item.title: Spanberger's Data Center Plan Conflicts With Party's Green Energy Goals, Critics Say
item.description: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger's data center plan limits natural gas generation while requiring grid reliability, raising questions about the gap between the two goals.

item.title: UK's Burnham Praises 'Good Connection' With Trump
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Tuesday that he and President Donald Trump had "established a good connection in our early discussions" despite differences.
